name: browser-use
headline: Claude Code plugin marketplace for Ruby & Rails
short_description: Claude Ruby Marketplace is a plugin marketplace for Ruby and Rails development. It enables developers to automate code quality checks, generate tests, and streamline development workflows. Integrates with Claude Code for AI-assisted development.
author: hoblin

sections.overview:
Claude Ruby Marketplace is a curated plugin collection for Ruby developers using Claude Code. It provides skills and tools for Rails development (RSpec, ActiveRecord, Draper, ruby-lsp), game development with DragonRuby, and terminal UI creation with RatatuiRuby. The marketplace includes testing patterns, ORM guidance, decorator implementations, and a research-planning-implementation workflow for AI-assisted coding. Developers can install individual plugins to extend Claude's capabilities for their specific Ruby projects.
Generate RSpec tests and use FactoryBot patterns for Rails applications
Build 2D games with DragonRuby using game loop and collision detection
Create terminal user interfaces with RatatuiRuby widgets and layouts
Implement ActiveRecord model patterns and database queries
